name: @w6w-apps/youcanbookme
description: Manage YouCanBookMe bookings, booking pages (profiles), appointment types and team members.

w6w.longDescription:
YouCanBookMe (YCBM) turns a calendar into a booking page: a visitor picks an open slot, fills in a form, and a booking (plus the underlying calendar event) is created automatically. This app brings that booking lifecycle into a workflow — list and read bookings across an account or a single booking page, create a booking directly (e.g. from a lead captured elsewhere), reschedule or cancel one, and delete it outright. It also covers a booking page's own setup: listing and reading booking pages (profiles), and adding the appointment types and team members that page offers.

YCBM scopes every call to a specific account (a UUID) and authenticates with HTTP Basic — the account id as username, an API key as password — so every action takes the account id as an explicit input. This release does not cover availability queries, remote calendar accounts, or raw calendar events: YCBM's own current documentation lists only Profiles, Bookings, Team Members and Appointment Types as the account-scoped surface it exposes today, and this app's own live probes confirmed the older `remoteaccounts` and `queries` endpoints (still present in an archived 2021 spec) now return 404 on the live API.
